title: What if every human vanished tonight? 🌃
subject: city
description:
Which building do you think would fall last? 👇

What would happen to Earth if all humans disappeared? New York's subway would flood, glass towers would crack, and in a century the city would turn into a forest.

Sources: NPR, "Imagining a World Without Humans" (Alan Weisman, The World Without Us, 2007); Popular Science, Sarah Durn, "How fast would NYC fall apart without people?" (2025, with Jana Horvat, University of Zagreb, and Peter Del Tredici, Harvard's Arnold Arboretum).
tags: what happens if humans go extinct

scenes.text: Without people, Earth's city lights would start fading within days.
scenes.nasa: earth at night city lights from ISS

scenes.text: Pumps under New York clear 13 million gallons of water from the subway daily. Author Alan Weisman says the tunnels would flood in 2 days.
scenes.nasa: New York City at night from ISS

scenes.text: Glass facades go first, says Zagreb architect Jana Horvat. Then the steel rusts.
The Empire State Building might last about 150 years.
Harvard botanist Peter Del Tredici says New York becomes a forest within a century.
From orbit, only lightning, wildfires and auroras would light the night.
